title: Cloud File Storage (4 levels)
description_html:
Build an in-memory cloud storage service that maps file names (paths) to metadata. No real file system.

Levels

  1. Level 1: files
    • add_file(name, size) returns true, or false if it exists
    • get_file_size(name)
    • delete_file(name)
  2. Level 2: largest files
    • get_n_largest(prefix, n) returns up to n files under the prefix as "name(size)", by size descending, then name ascending
  3. Level 3: users and capacity
    • add_user(user_id, capacity)
    • add_file_by(user_id, name, size) succeeds only within the user's remaining capacity
    • Some versions add merge_user(a, b)
  4. Level 4: backup and restore
    • backup_user(user_id) snapshots the user's files, replacing any earlier backup
    • restore_user(user_id) brings them back; with no backup, the user's files are deleted; capacity is unchanged

Progressive round: each level unlocks after the previous one passes. Write level 1 so later levels extend it rather than rewrite it.

Source: Ramp CodeSignal OA (1point3acres) and PracHub cloud-storage write-ups (also CloudKitchens). Candidate-reported; exact wording varies between reports.
